options.name: api_key
options.description: Account API token. Note that these type of keys are deprecated and might stop working at some point. Use personal access tokens instead. One of O(personal_access_token) and O(api_key) must be specified.

options.name: domain
options.description: The name of the Domain to work with (for example, V(example.com)).

options.name: personal_access_token
options.description: Scoped API token. One of O(personal_access_token) and O(api_key) must be specified.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the record(s) should exist or not.

options.name: ttl
options.description: The TTL to give the new record. Required when O(state=present).

options.name: type
options.description: The type of DNS record to create.

options.name: values
options.description: The record values. Required when O(state=present).
